answer_1.quote: Text-Centric Visual Question Answering (TEC-VQA) has become a crucial benchmark for evaluating AI's ability to understand text-rich visual scenes.
answer_1.outputs: multilingual textual answers to visual questions

answer_2.quote: We adopt chrF for its robustness to spelling variants and morphological diversity... define a Custom Binary Accuracy (CBA)... incorporate Accuracy (Acc)... and Visual-Textual Similarity (vtS)... Therefore, we adopt Acc as the primary metric and chrF as the secondary reference.

answer_4.quote: To establish an upper-bound reference, we include a human benchmark based on five native-speaking annotators per language; we report both the best individual score (Human_best) and the average (Human_avg).
answer_4.guideline: Native speakers provide reference answers for scoring model outputs via automatic metrics
